title: Intelligence Brief
headline: HackerBooks, today's #1 Hacker News story
subtitle: HackerBooks, today's #1 Hacker News story, has a, Anthropic quietly added an undisableable, Proton CEO Andy Yen canceled mandatory staff

heroStat.label: points on "HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN"

insights.text: HackerBooks, today's #1 Hacker News story, has a different developer reproduce Andrej Karpathy's HackerTube method within 24 hours of his original post: Claude Opus 5.5 scans Hacker News comments from 2007-2026 and extracts 16,543 distinct book mentions, ranked by frequency, with Snow Crash topping the list at 1,004 mentions.

Anthropic quietly added an undisableable system-prompt rule to Claude Opus 5.5 inside Claude Code blocking recreation of existing video games, confirmed by an Anthropic engineer as 'two sentences added to the prompt' — developers report the same rule also blocking unrelated work like crash-dump analysis and anti-cheat development.

Proton CEO Andy Yen canceled mandatory staff 're-interviews' about AI usage — originally described as able to affect 'continued employment' — after a 404 Media investigation and internal backlash, though employees say AI use could still factor into ordinary performance reviews.

A deep read of Anthropic's full S-1 filing finds the company's financials 'surprisingly strong' — revenue hit $16.8B in Q3, it posted its first-ever operating profit in Q2, and its cash reserves trail only Google and Berkshire Hathaway among non-bank companies — in direct tension with last week's report that Anthropic is expected to receive a high 'junk' credit rating on one debt tranche.

thedotmack/claude-mem holds GitHub Trending #1 for a third consecutive day, but its star velocity moderates to roughly +1,479/day — down from +1,723/day yesterday — the first sign of post-peak deceleration after two days of acceleration.
Google Gemini jumps from #9 to #4 in today's Play Store top-30 capture, its best rank across three consecutive tracked days, while Grok, Claude, and ChatGPT are all absent.

Google's NotebookLM, rebranded for the second time as 'Gemini Notebook,' appears in today's Play Store top 30 (#19, 4.8★) — its 203K reviews and 4.79★ rating carried intact through two name changes, a naming-churn case study most indie apps can't assume survives a rebrand.
insights.source: Google Play Store scrape / app registry cross-check, 2026-11-02

insights.text: Qwen3.8-27B, the exact model behind yesterday's memdoor/GVS5H open-weight-ensemble benchmark claim, is today's #13 Hugging Face trending model (18,946 likes, 7.89M downloads) — a demand-side echo of the benchmark story.

takeaway.text: Karpathy's agent-as-publisher method already has a copycat — proof the pattern transfers to someone other than Karpathy — while Anthropic quietly hands Claude Code a policy decision it can't be told to ignore, a small but telling sign of where harness control is actually settling.
